svg.title: Repo constellation - smaller builds grouped by theme
svg.desc: Star map of smaller repositories grouped into constellations. FastAPI patterns: fastapi_practices, fastapi_sql_aws_base. Frontend and 3D: Babylon_Vue (Vue 3 + Babylon.js PBR), react-basics-rejuvenation, AngularInMemoryCompanyAdmin. Containers: flask_mongo_dockerized, heroku_deploy_flask. DSA galaxy: dsa_algo (140 files), blind_leetcode_python (53 problem files). Tools: github-stats (Flask + pygal language charts).
svg.text: Flask + Mongo in Docker · Heroku deploy
